name: Will I save money by continuing FSBO or is hiring an agent more cost-effective in the long run?

mainEntity.name: Will I save money by continuing FSBO or is hiring an agent more cost-effective in the long run?

acceptedAnswer.text: While FSBO aims to save commission costs, it often involves significant time and effort for marketing, showings, and negotiations. Many FSBO sellers also risk underselling their property due to a lack of market knowledge or negotiation skills. Hiring an agent, while incurring commission fees, can lead to a higher sale price, faster sale, and fewer issues, potentially resulting in a greater net profit. Agents also provide access to professional services like photography and staging that can enhance your home's appeal and value in competitive markets like Miami-Dade and Broward.
acceptedAnswer.description: While FSBO avoids commission, agents often secure higher sale prices and faster transactions, potentially leading to greater overall profit and less hassle.
